cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Try a grape before we buy the bunch. Last week's were sour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Just one. I'll try the next if nobody objects.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but you're holding the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it out like samples. You take the first one; if that works, I'll serve myself.

mechanism: A approves another shopper testing a forbidden grape first, treating B conditions as requests for sanctioned exceptions.
confusable: A confident invitation to misbehave is not enough; A must grant permissions while postponing personal rule-breaking.
comparison: The shopper negotiates public visibility rather than the bride ceremonial precedence and train assistance.
seedUse: D08-b supplies a no-tasting sign and a visible bunch; S01 changes the sample offer into an assumed approval hierarchy.
